reviews.title: Mostly good coffee maker.
reviews.body: Works perfectly, brews great coffee. Even the scoop they provided with it is the perfect size for me. It has one problem that is minor for me, because I only make five cups, but may be catastrophic for someone making a full pot. The problem is that the cover of the basket area and water tank appears to lock while brewing, apparently so you don't burn yourself, but if you don't close the lid tightly, the machine will brewing the coffee with an open cover, and also the ball at the bottom of the basket doesn't go down far enough to allow the carafe cover to push the button on the basket, so the water just stays with the grounds in the basket. Intuitively, it seems the tank could overflow. Except for that it's worth the modest pricr.

reviews.author: Carmen Meredith

reviews.title: Started great, now needs tricks to fully brew.
reviews.body: Looks great. Out of the box we were pleased with it. The locking lid and auto shutoff was a great addition. It would brew a whole pot in under 10mins. We were very pleased with it minus the minor issue of steam buildup leaking from the back onto the counter when lifting the lid.The main issue is that after 2 months of using filtered water, the machine no longer brews quickly. The inside is clean, no buildup but for whatever reason it starts up runs about 2 cups through then stops for anywhere between 3-15mins before starting once more. It now takes nearly a full hour to brew a pot and there are no guarantees it will be finished without having to shut it off, back on and jump start it to continue. Buyer beware.I wish it would have happened within the return window. We liked it, but not now.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 20, 2026
reviews.author: KJF

reviews.title: Not bad, lightweight and basic, just not for me.
reviews.body: If you’re looking for something basic, that doesn’t feel super well-made then this coffee pot will work. But I drink coffee every morning. I love my home coffee and I need a pot that will last and be reliable.  It just didn’t seem like a coffee pot that would hold up over time and so I returned it. I had to upgrade. There was nothing wrong with it, per se, just a simple on and off button, not sure how long it would hold up, I didn’t have it that long, but it felt too cheap for what I wanted. If you’re just looking for a simple basic coffee pot, that may or may not hold up, this would be fitting.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 12, 2026

features: Generous Capacity & Durable Design: Glass carafe with 60oz capacity, this allows you to brew a large amount of coffee up to 12 full cups, or simply choose 2 or 4 at a time. It has an easy-grip handle for comfortable, drip-free pouring. The dishwasher safe carafe coffee pot is made of high-quality, non-porous borosilicate glass, which won’t absorb odors, while its superb heat-resistance will keep your coffee hotter for Ionger.

Reusable Eco-Filter: Our permanent filter technology not only enriches the flavor of your coffee but also saves you the cost and waste of disposable filters. Easy to remove and clean, however filter paper can still be used if you prefer. Savor the flavor in every refill.

Improved Keep Warm Safety: Our keep-warm function maintains your coffee's temperature, ensuring your last cup is as warm as the first. After your machine has brewed a fresh carafe of coffee, the warming plate will retain heat, and then will automatically turn off after 2 hours. Perfect for busy mornings or leisurely brunches.
Thoughtful Features: This coffee machine comes with a non-drip carafe and non-slip feet for stability, ensuring your brewing experience is clean and safe.
